review_description: The supplier and installer of the system was very through and provided us with training on the system and a detailed manual for our installation.

Hello Finn, I would like to take this opportunity to thank you for the information you provided, it was a great help. The reason I went with the contractor I used is, he supplied and installed the system and connected it to the grid. So I only had to deal with one person. He also provided me with more useful information than the others, both written and verble.Kind Regard's, Terry
